WTF? A Lost African Tribe Complete With A King Have Set Up Camp In...Wait For It...The Woodlands Of Scotland
A couple who claim they are part of a lost African tribe are facing a lot of questions and criticism after setting up home in the woodlands of Scotland.
The Kingdom of Kubala claims they have settled in a forest in Jedburgh, to reclaim land that was stolen from their ancestors 400 years ago - and the tribe's King has today even claimed to be a descendant of the Messiah.
